batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c CA Lynn b MS Gony

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b DW Steyn

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b V Pratap Singh

batting.name: PA Reddy
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b SK Trivedi

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c A Chandila b J Botha

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b STR Binny

batting.name: CA Lynn
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b SK Trivedi

balls.text: short of length, outside the off stump, wanted to pull it, away missed, they run for a bye, Patel was waiting for it, he collected it, rushed in and throws the stumps down at the striker's end, Shah has not yet got to the crease and the umpire gives it out!
full-toss, misses the outside edge and flicks the stumps on its way to the keeper, bowled!
on the middle stump, he was moving to the off side, flicked away to fine-leg for only one
short of length, pulled away from outside the off stump and there is a misfield at the fence from Dhawan, allowing them to come back for the second
on the leg stump, gives room, opens the face of the bat to the off side for a single
pitched up, smacked it over the bowler's head and it looked like it was going to the fence, but well fielded, sliding stop from Duminy running in from long-on, restricts the batsman to two
full-toss, he was giving room, came into him and he has pulled it to mid-wicket, come back for a second, end of an excellent spell from the South African
short ball, tries to pull it away, top-edge and that has been caught well by the bowler, to his right, there was a fielder running in from mid-wicket but Steyn calmly pouches it
half volley on his pads and that should have been dispatched, instead he has hit it on the bounce to fine-leg and only for a single
short ball, outside the off stump and probably moving away, he was going for the pull, gets an outside edge over point but way in front of the sweeper and they get one
was giving himself some room, delivered slower from Steyn, wanted to pull it but missed, Patel fumbles behind the stumps and they run a bye
on the off stump, short of length, pushed to the covers and they are away for a quick single
on the length and dips into the batsman, inside edge and they are able to rush away for a single
slower this time, outside the off stump, keeps a little low, pushed to mid-on for a single
on the off stump, short of length, pushed to the off side and to the fielder
shot, four! length ball and Shah has picked it up from there and deposited it the backward square-leg for a four!

cut away and into the hands of the deep point fielder! Dhawan had dropped one earlier but he gets his second catch this time, it was short, wide and deserved that shot, except that it needed to be played in the gap, instead it went straight down the throat of the fielder and to everyone's relief around, it went to hand.
short ball, comes quicker on to the batsman, tries to hook it away, gets high on the bat and goes to fine-leg for only one
quicker ball this time, 123.1 km/hr, flicked away and in the air, between deep square-leg and fine-leg, Dhawan chases it down and fields well, they get two for it though
slower one again, on the front foot and pushed to the covers for a single
was sitting on the back foot, it was a very slow ball, and in the end the batsman scoops it over the bowler, only for a single
finally, freeing of arms from the batsman, shorter ball and it has been pulled away, lands on the rope at deep square-leg!
outside the off stump, wanted to hit it over mid-on, mistimed again and the run-rate's dipped below six
shorter from Reddy, slower too and the pull shot goes straight to the deep square-leg fielder, only a single
quicker ball, short of length, tries to late it, misses it easily and that means only three of the over!
round the stumps, angling in, pushed to the point fielder and again it is a dot
outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single
140.6 km/hr, outside the off stump, good length ball, defended to the covers
short ball and Shah swivels away, gets a bit of a top-edge and it spoons up but luckily for the Chargers fielders, in no-man's land!
outside the off stump, short of length, punched but straight to short covers, where White fields
short of length, gives enough time for the left-hander to work it away to the deep and come back for a second
another wrong 'un, goes for a swing over the mid-wicket, misses
on the off stump, top-spinner, Menaria does not know where it was going and he defends it in the end
delicate, outside the off stump, slower once again, opens the face of the bat, guides it through point, beats the short third-man and point fielder for a four!
turn and appeal!, that was turning away, lot of it, hits the pad but not before it flicked the outside edge of the bat, umpire gives it not-out, brilliant decision!
pitched up, slower, outside the off stump, driven to the sweeper for a single
and again, not too much in the batsman's half and the short ball is tucked away to the leg side for a single
on the middle stump, short of length yet again, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
on the middle stump, short of length, lot of bounce and hits the pads, appeal for a leg-before but the umpire was never going to give that one out.
short of length, goes on to the back foot, opens the face of the bat, played away to the third-man
length ball yet again, pushed to the leg side for a single
bouncer again, on the back foot, almost deflects back on to the stumps and Shah tries to swat it away too, he misses that
bouncer from Gony, ducks under it and it looks to be over the head, called a wide
on the off stump, moves to the off and flicks it away to mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, moves in the crease to the off side, but it is too wide outside and given too
pitched right up to the bat, on the middle stump, driven to the mid-off region for a single
moves around the crease, he gets one on the middle, flicked away to mid-wicket region for a single
outside the off stump, knocks it to the leg side, gently and they are able to come back for the second run because the fielder was far, far away
outside the off stump, bit of a turn, opens the face of the bat, to short third-man for a single
pitched right up to the bat, flighted and punched to the mid-on region
gone, caught and that is after a wobble too! Outside the off stump, width given and he went for a slash, goes high in the air and straight to the sweeper, who managed to almost make a mess of it!
short ball, on the body, pulled away by Shah to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, short of length and he drives it through to the sweeper for a single
on the length, middle stump, flicked away to square-leg for a single
short of length, defended on his back foot, back to the bowler
short of good length, brings his front foot away and slogs it to the deep square-leg for a single
quicker one, straighter, outside the off stump and Dravid went for a slog, gets an inside edge, to short fine-leg for a single
googly, into the bat, bowled well enough but sadly for the bowler, he has overstepped, no-ball and Free Hit!
on the leg stump, Dravid brings his foot out, flicked away to the leg-side for a single
shortish, goes on to the back foot, punched back to the bowler
cut away and this time it is in the gap, the fielder at sweeper had to run to his left before which they come back for the second
shortish length, pushes to the deep square-leg for a single
short of length, spinning away, cuts away to the sweeper for a single
pitched up and driven well by Shah but it goes straight to mid-off
length ball, short of length and punched to the off side for nothing
short ball, pull attempted from Dravid, rolls his wrists over the ball to square-leg
edged and for a four, short of length, bit of width and Dravid went for a cut, gets a top edge and it goes through the slips, non-existent ones, and into the fence
on the off stump, pitched up, driven to short cover and straight to the fielder, White
on the middle stump, pitched up, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
wants to cut away, shorter this time, mistimed from Dravid and ends an excellent second over from Mishra
rips away from Shah this one, beats the outside edge and hits the pads, he was outside the off stump and a misfield at the slips allows them to cross over for a single

bowled him again, and this time it is off the wrong 'un! Where was this Mishra before in the tournament? He is getting them to rip away and this one is pitched on the off stump, he went for the cut thinking it was going to turn away, instead it came in and sneaked through the defences!
fuller, driven down the ground to long-off for a single
pitched slightly up, tries to go on to the back foot and drives to short cover, where White fields well
short of length but turning away from the bat, wanted to cut it away but the turn defeats the power in the shot
on the leg side, bit more bounce on this one than Dravid expected, he wanted to flick it away, hits the thigh pad and they get a single
length ball but down the leg side, Dravid wanted to flick it away, misses it and wide called
immediately pulls up the length, but on the middle and it is tucked away to fine leg for a single
pitched up and this time Binny punches it over the bowler, the mid-off was up in the circle and he gets a four
pitched up this time, defended on to the off side, again, no run, bit of impatience can be sensed here
another short of length, rises a little more than the batsman expected, hits high on the bat, to the off side
short ball and pulled away by Dravid, that was nowhere near the middle of the bat and it lobs up towards fine-leg for a single
punched back to the bowler, to his left and he allows it go through for that customary one misfield an over.
down the track and through the extra-cover region, was in the air and Duminy dived to his left, but this was NOT a drop.
on the middle, fuller, Dravid comes on to the front foot and taps it away to short fine-leg
down the track, outside the off stump, driven through the covers for a single
on the off stump, bit of a turn away and defended on the front foot
bowled him! Pitched on the middle, probably drifting in and then spins away to hit the off stump, Watson's walking back after his 13-ball essay
pitched up this one, on the stumps and Dravid was trying to drive it, inside edge and goes to fine-leg for a streaky boundary
short of length on the middle and Dravid gives himself room, moves away and slashes the ball over the covers, in much like the same fashion as Sourav Ganguly did in the ODIs in his prime
pitched right up to the batsman, driven to mid-on but goes quickly and they do not get a single
outside the off stump, gently opens the face of the bat and to third-man for a single
shortish again, wanted to pull it, gets an under-edge on to the pads and goes to square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, rising a tad and Dravid needed to take his hand off the bat to keep it down, to short cover
and he makes you pay for the drops, pitched slightly up and that has been tonked over the straight boundary for a 86 metre long six.
short ball, pulled away to deep square-leg for a single

dropped, again? How can they do this to their bowlers? drilled to mid-on and it was going quickly to the fielder, who tips it over the bar at that position to the fence for a four! This is really poor from the Chargers
dropped again, more difficult this time but Dhawan should have caught it, flicked it away to a one that is pitched up and the diving Dhawan floors it!
length ball on the off stump, driven to the off side, mistimed and straight to the short cover fielder
short of good length, Watson is on the back foot and defends perfectly to the off side
pitched up outside the off stump, driving length and Watson gently pushes it to the wide mid-off region for a single
drifts on to the pads of Dravid this time, 146.6 km/hr, flicked away to fine-leg, travels very quickly to the fielder who gets behind it and they get only a single
on the off stump, pitched on the length and driven to the off side and to short cover
on the off stump, shaping away from the bat, defended away to the off side
dabbed away to the third-man, outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and through the second slip region and to the left of third-man for a four
outside the off stump, on a length and Dravid has a fiddle at it, misses the outside edge and it goes through to Patel.
shorter again this time, but change of line, more on the body and Watson's attempted pull results in nothing, hit by that one too after missing the bat
outside the off stump again but this time it on a length and defended to the off side by Watson
short ball from Gony, outside the off stump and Watson has pulled it away through mid-wicket for a four!
on the middle stump, pitched up, flicked away to wide mid-on for a single
on the off stump, short of length, driven back to the bowler
on the middle, on to the front foot, played away to mid-on
outside the off stump and Watson pokes at it tentatively, misses, stroke brought about by the previous delivery
short ball, rising from a length and Watson has to jump and fend at it, it went so quickly that Watson was looking elsewhere while the ball looped up to the off side
quicker this time, angling into the bat, dabbed away to the leg side

edged and gone, caught in the slips! That was on the middle again, swinging slightly away from the bat, Rahane was looking to play it to the leg side, on the back foot but the deviation finds the outside edge of the bat and goes through to the lone slip in place, caught by Dhawan.
on the middle, drifting down the leg, wants to flick it away, gets a leading edge to the off side and for a single
on the off stump, pitched up, driven well by Rahane, the diving fielder a mid-off stops it
shorter again, on the leg stump, on to the back foot, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single
shorter once again, rocks back on to the back foot and punched through the covers, in the gap this time and for four
shorter, outside the off stump, cut away and straight to the covers
outside the off stump, fuller, driven to short cover
outside edge and dropped! Outside the off stump, drifting away, went for the drive, edged and put down
round the wicket, on the middle, forced away on the front foot to deep square-leg for a single

shot, four, win! Pitched right up to the bat and Reddy has punched it over the bowler for a four! Deccan have won their second match at Hyderabad in four years and it is a moment to celebrate for the home team!
full-toss, outside the off stump, he has drilled it through the covers and that has gone all the way! Excellent shot under pressure!
yorker-length ball from Tait, 147 km/hr, bit of in-swing, defended away to the off side
on the middle stump, quick and he has defended it to the leg side, the fielder at fine-leg needs to come in but by that time they can come back for a valuable brace
stunning, pitched up and Duminy has lofted him and straight into the hands of the long-on fielder!
short of length, dabbed away to the leg side, the bowler runs to his left, picks up and shies at non-striker's end, misses, had it hit, the batsman was back!
slower, outside the off stump, played away to the point region, they are off for a quick single, Rahane has a shy, misses
shorter, slower and pulled away to the deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump and quicker, he opened the face of the bat at the 11th hour, just under his nose, the third-man was up and that has gone away
short of length, outside the off stump, flicked away to mid-wicket for a single
slows it down, pitched up, he goes down the track and drives to mid-wicket for a single

swept away, well-played, they come back for the third by the time Tait slides at fine-leg and saves the four, third umpire called in and it seems like he was touching the ball and fence at the same time. Umpire sees it otherwise and calls it three.
shorter run-up, flicked away to short fine-leg, they rush for a single, shy at non-striker's end, would have been a run-out had it hit
slower, wants to drive it away, gets an inside edge, hits the pads
quicker, on the stumps from round the wickets, slight turn, defended
pitched up, punched down the ground for a single, to long-off
on his pads, pitched right up, flicked away to fine-leg, who is squarer and runs to his left, by which time they get back for the second
short ball, but it wasn't too quick, he tried to pull it away and that has gone straight down the throat of the deep fielder, do not tell me this game will turn around from here!
short outside the off stump yet again, cut away by Duminy, to deep cover region for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, wants to cut away, misses, required rate is six
flicked away to the leg side for a single to deep square-leg
outside the off stump, short of length, opens the face of the bat, to third-man for a single
driven to long-off for a single, end of his four-over spell for 20 runs
was coming down the pitch, wanted to play it away, but the shortness of the ball does not allow him too much leeway
short of length, goes on to the back foot, nudged away to square-leg where they come back for the second run, excellent placement
on the leg, wants to loft it away, does not get in the middle, played away to mid-wicket for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven back to the bowler
short of length, flicked away to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, defended it to the off side and that ends a decent over from Tait
yorker length on the off stump, defended back without too much of a back-lift there
length ball, on the off stump, defended to the off side, 148.1 km/hr
short of length, he opens the face of the bat, allows it to come on and it is dabbed away to third-man and that has gone away to the fence
way down the leg side, allows it to go through and that is a wide
outside the off stump, quicker as well, driven through the covers, single to the sweeper fielder
quicker, on the off stump, flicked to the left of the bowler, no run
short of length, outside the off stump, defended back to the bowler and no run
gone, caught and bowled! slower one, short of length and it has been punched back to the bowler, Chandila has a wicket!
pitched up, slower, punched back to the bowler, fielded well
goes down the track, the ball was turning away, driven on the up to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, driven to long-on for a single
outside the leg stump, wanted to paddle it away, hits the pads and despite the appeal, they are away for a leg-bye
length ball, bit of bounce outside the off stump, beats his outside edge, through to the keeper
short of length and down the leg side, very wide and the keeper, up to the stumps, did well to stop that

slower one, on the leg side, wanted to flick it away to the leg side, gets a leading edge and it balloons up for Shah at mid-off, running back. He kept his eyes on the ball throughout and caught it well
on the middle, pitched up, tries to flick it away, bit of an inside edge on to the pads, drops in front of the batsman
on his pads, quicker this time and that has been flicked away to the leg side, beats the fine-leg fielder and it easily rolls over the fence for a four
length ball, outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, guides it to third-man for a single
shorter from the bowler, slower too, pulled it away to the deep square-leg region for a couple of runs

pitched up to the bat, wants to slog it, does not get it off the middle of the bat again, but is able to get it to deep square-leg, they get one with ease and then, after a stutter, they come back for the second
slower, rocks back on to the back foot and cuts it away hard, only for a single to deep cover
slower, outside the off stump, opens the face of the ball, played away to the off side
and use of feet yet again, nudges it away to deep square-leg, bisects the field and they come back for a second
pitched right up to the bat, goes down the pitch, drives it to long-on for a single
shorter one, on the middle stump, goes on to the back foot, cut away to the off side for a single
slower one, short of length, wants to pull it away, misses getting it off the middle of the bat, to the square-leg fielder, the required rate is creeping back to six
on the off stump, pushed to the off side and they are able to get away for a single
short ball, attempted bouncer, that has gone over the batsman for a wide
on the middle, pitched up, flicked away to square-leg for a single
short of length, opens the face of the bat, plays it down to third-man for a single
on the middle, short of length, defended on the back foot again
short of length, on to the back foot, defended on the off side
pitched up, on the off stump, driven to the long-off fielder for a single
immediately down the track, drives the ball to short mid-wicket, where Watson fields
outside the off stump, short of length, played it away to the leg side for a single
goes down the track, tries to hit it over the in-field, instead he gets a lot of elevation on that and Chandila runs around, keeps his eye on the ball and more importantly, holds on to the catch
pitched up, on his pads, tries to whip it through the leg side, but the inside edge goes to the fine-leg for a single
on the middle stump, straighter, fuller and he was attempting the sweep, was that missing the leg?
outside the off stump, wants to drive it through the point region, but to the fielder
shorter ball from the bowler, pulls it away, was a slower one too, to the fielder for a single
on his pads this time, nudged away to deep square leg for a single
shorter again, not enough to pull, not full to drive, tries to work it away to the leg side, misses
short of length again, punched through to point, straight to the fielder, Rahane, two dots
short of length, goes down the track and wants to work away through the off side, straight to the fielder
slower in the air, down the track, wanted to spank it over the bowler, checks his shot and that calls for a Time-Out
on the middle, nudged away but to short fine-leg
oooh! on the pads, he was moving towards the off, kept low and misses the lg stump
short of length, goes on to the back foot, played away to long-on for a single
now Dhawan comes down the track, the ball is on the leg stump and he misses it, hits the pads
pitched up and goes down the track, drives to long-on for a single
short of length, nudged away for a single to square-leg and that brings an end to the Powerplay overs
down the track yet again and this time he has deposited it into the boundary, the mid-on remained up in the circle, the feet were well used
and goes down the track yet again, the mid-on was up in the circle, hits it over the fielder and gets another four!
down the track and hits it over mid-wicket, there is a fielder in the deep, Watson moves to his left and they come back for a second
fuller this time, angle this time, tries to sweep it away, misses, hits the pads and there is an appeal there, given not-out
shorter from Botha but a lot of turn takes it down the leg side for a wide
pitched up, on the middle, driven to mid-wicket and there is no run
short ball, a very quick bouncer, 152.7 km/hr, one of the quickest deliveries of the season, he went for the hook, gets a top edge and that has cleared the boundary behind the keeper for a maximum!
on the middle stump, short of length, flick attempted, hits the pads and they are away for a single
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, driven to mid-off, 147.4 km/hr
short of a length, middle stump, keeps a tad low, punched back to the bowler
on the middle stump, flicked away to fine-leg, he has to run to his left and by the time the throw comes in, they are able to get it away for a couple
length ball, swinging into the bat, inside edge and they are away quickly for a single, good running by the pair
yes, he attempts another shorter one at Reddy, who is waiting that one now, flicked away over the square-leg region and done well this time, for a brace
outside the off stump, pitched fuller, driven through to the covers, bit of a fumble and they are off for a single
length ball outside the off stump, punched to the off side, to short covers
short ball, goes for a hook but hits his gloves and it drops down to the leg side for a single
pulls his length back, short of length, misses the outside edge of the bat, through to the keeper
on the middle stump, pitched right up to the bat and it was in the slot to hit it over mid-wicket, flicked for four!
short of length, went for the pull, but it was too quick for the batsman, can only manage to get it away within the circle for a single
and now a wide down the leg side, three already in the over
length ball, swinging into the batsman, 140.9 km/hr, pushed to the off side for a quick single
and now a wide down the leg side, he has begun to crank them up, now for him to get the areas right
short of length, quicker as well from Tait, 149.9 km/hr, tries to flick it away, but hits his pads before he has got his bat down!
outside the off stump and for the fourth time this over, fuller, timed well but to the extra-cover fielder and for no runs
finally gets his line right, yorker-length on the middle and swinging into the batsman, dug out by the batsman.
outside the off stump yet again and pitched up, he was going for the drive, misses it but it was too wide outside the off stump
outside the off stump, wide and the batsman had difficulty reaching to it, squeezed away through the covers for a four!
bouncer and easily ducked under the ball, six runs off the Watson over
on the middle, pitched up and that has been flicked away, dive by the mid-wicket fielder to his left but was out of reach and it beats the in-field
outside the off stump again, pitched fuller, tries to drive it away but mistimed again, goes gently to mid-off, allowing them to cross over for a single
down the track, pitches wider outside the off stump, goes for a drive, misses, through to the keeper
outside the off stump, pitched on length, driven but mistimed to off side
outside the off stump, swinging away, driven to wide mid-off for a single
quicker, shorter, on to the back foot and defended back to the bowler
floated up again and this has been swept away to deep square-leg for a four!
goes down the track and smacks it over the in-field, over long-on for a six!
on the leg stump, probably turning in, drifting in, hits the pads
pitched up again, on the middle again, driven to the long-on for a single
on the middle, pitched up, driven to mid-on
